It is believed to be the name of the Goddess of Prosperity and Wealth. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted as holding a lotus or a pot filled with gold coins. She is invoked for financial success and material abundance. The name Dodiya is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the deity of wealth and prosperity in Hinduism.
